name: omniscient/omnisearch
description: Omnisearch: search the way Doctrine is for SQL, whatever the engine - indexes declared on the classes by attributes (#[Index], #[Field]), connections and drivers, requests and responses (DBAL), a manager, finders, queries, results and objects loaded back, the indexing rule (ORM); an in-memory engine, a Doctrine bridge and a Symfony bundle. Engines are packages of their own (omnisearch/typesense).

suggest.doctrine/orm: Doctrine's entities behind the documents (Omnisearch\Bridge\Doctrine): loaded back from a search, indexed on Doctrine's events
suggest.symfony/config: In a Symfony application: the configuration of Omnisearch\Bridge\Symfony\OmnisearchBundle
suggest.symfony/dependency-injection: In a Symfony application: the services of Omnisearch\Bridge\Symfony\OmnisearchBundle
suggest.symfony/console: In a Symfony application: the omnisearch:* commands
